title: Riverside School
story: A school records students, courses, and enrolments. A grade is empty until the course is finished, and a student can repeat a course.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE students (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, year_group INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE courses (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, subject TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE enrolments (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, student_id INTEGER NOT NULL, course_id INTEGER NOT NULL, grade INTEGER, term TEXT NOT NULL);
